policy: Only headwords with no English Wiktionary sense are listed. A close definition is the English gloss of a variant (case, optional marks, inflection-table form, Uzbek transliteration, or Arabic clitic removal) in the same Wiktionary language. It is not the headword's own definition; nothing is selected or approved.
